author: 爱奈丽+znq19
description: Token usage stats dashboard for KiraAI: per-round usage logging (input/output/cached tokens), cost estimation with peak/off-peak pricing rules and dual currency (CNY/points), API balance monitoring (auto/custom/newapi/preset/daily/rolling with anchor calibration), error stats, WebUI dashboard with KPI sparklines, trend drill-down and per-session stats with real names (dm/gm grouped), borderless draggable widget with ball mode, bot tools (overview/aggregation/records) and custom commands.

zh.description: Token 用量统计看板：逐轮记录输入/输出/缓存 tokens，按价格规则估算费用（峰谷价、CNY/积分双币种），API 余额监测（自动探测/自定义接口/New-API/预设扣减/每日重置/每日累计，支持当前余额对表校准），错误统计，WebUI 侧边栏仪表盘（KPI 走势 + 时间趋势下钻 + 会话级统计（显示昵称/群名，按私聊/群聊归类）+ 无边框可拖动挂件（球模式+随机背景）），bot 工具（概览/维度聚合/逐轮明细）与自定义命令查询。
